context_requirements: Intact G-protein signaling (Gi/o, Gq, or G12/13)
Serum-free or low-serum conditions to minimize basal S1P receptor activation
falsifiers: No significant change in any of the proximal immediate-early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN) at 6 h in any cell line
No decrease in proliferation-associated genes at 24 h in any cell line
A response profile indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine cell lines

changes: Moved CDKN1A from proximal_down to proximal_up: S1PR1 activation induces p21 (CDKN1A) via Gi/o and RhoA, causing G1 arrest.
Moved FOXO3 and FOXO4 from proximal_down to proximal_up: S1PR1-mediated PI3K/Akt inhibition activates FOXO transcription factors.
Moved RPS6 and EIF4EBP1 from proximal_down to proximal_up: S1PR1 signaling can activate mTORC1, increasing phosphorylation and transcription of these genes.
Removed MYBL2, CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, TOP2A from proximal_down: these are late cell-cycle genes, not proximal S1PR1 targets; they remain in late_down.
Removed CCND1 and MYC from proximal_down: these are early-response genes often upregulated by S1PR1, not downregulated; they remain in late_down.

Removed generic proliferation genes (CCND1, MYC, CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, TOP2A, PCNA, MCM3, E2F2, MYBL2, UBE2C) from late_down: these are generic proliferation markers, not specific to S1PR1 agonism.

Removed generic stress and inflammatory genes (CCL2, CXCL2, ICAM1, IL1B, PTGS2, SERPINE1, TIMP2, MMP1, MMP2, CD44, TGFB3, EDN1, SPP1, COL1A1, COL4A1) from late_up: these are generic stress/inflammatory genes, not specific to S1PR1 agonism.
Removed generic_effects 'proliferation_down' and 'g1_arrest': these are generic outcomes, not specific to S1PR1 agonism.
Changed kinetics from 'fast' to 'moderate': S1PR1-mediated transcriptional responses typically peak at 1-2 h for immediate-early genes and later for secondary genes, not 'fast'.
Changed magnitude 6h from 'moderate' to 'weak': S1PR1 agonist effects on transcription at 6 h are often weak in many cell lines.
Changed magnitude 24h from 'moderate' to 'weak': S1PR1 agonist effects on transcription at 24 h are often weak in many cell lines.
Changed line_response for A375, A549, HCC515, HEPG2, HT29, MCF7, PC3, VCAP from 'moderate' to 'weak': these lines have variable S1PR1 expression and may not respond strongly.
Changed line_response for HA1E from 'weak' to 'none': HA1E is an immortalized normal cell line with low S1PR1 expression and may not respond.
Removed all evidence citations: no evidence provided.
